subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: When an administrator switches credentials, should global auth refresh let in-flight turns finish with their original credential snapshot or cancel them before recreating every affected binding?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but repository behavior cannot determine the intended credential cutoff and disruption boundary across active agents and channels.

options.title: Refresh idle bindings
options.body: Refresh idle bindings immediately while preserving session records, and allow already-running turns to finish with their original credential snapshot.

options.title: Cancel and refresh all
options.body: Cancel all affected runs before recreating bindings, enforcing an immediate credential cutoff at the cost of greater disruption.

options.title: Keep per-session control
options.body: Decline a global operation and retain explicit refresh or reset of each individual session.

recommendation.title: Refresh idle bindings
recommendation.body: Refresh idle bindings immediately while preserving session records, and allow already-running turns to finish with their original credential snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history and discussion signals are in the Gateway/session lifecycle work and the prior review of this exact boundary.
